blocks.zh: 概覽：QMSR 轉換與 2024 最終規則
blocks.en: Overview: The QMSR Transition and the 2024 Final Rule

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 解釋 FDA 為何在 2024 年發布最終規則，將 21 CFR Part 820 從 QSR（Quality System Regulation）轉換為 QMSR（Quality Management System Regulation），以及 ISO 13485:2016 引用納入的法律意義
blocks.en: Explain why FDA issued a final rule in 2024 to convert 21 CFR Part 820 from the QSR (Quality System Regulation) to the QMSR (Quality Management System Regulation), and the legal significance of incorporating ISO 13485:2016 by reference

blocks.zh: 比較 QSR（1996）舊架構（§§820.20–820.250 共 15 個子部分）與 QMSR 新架構（Subpart A、Subpart B，其餘 Subparts C–O 保留空置），掌握結構性變化對現有品質系統的衝擊
blocks.en: Compare the old QSR (1996) architecture (§§820.20–820.250, 15 subparts) with the new QMSR architecture (Subpart A and Subpart B, with Subparts C–O reserved), and understand how the structural change affects existing quality systems

blocks.zh: 確認 QMSR 合規義務對象的範圍——Class I、II、III 醫療器材製造商、組合產品廠商、合約製造商——以及豁免的情境（純元件製造商）
blocks.en: Confirm who must comply with the QMSR (manufacturers of Class I, II and III medical devices, combination product manufacturers and contract manufacturers) and the situations that are exempt (component-only manufacturers)

blocks.zh: 從無菌注射劑 CDMO 角度，分析預充式注射器（pre-filled syringe）和自動注射器（autoinjector）的器材組成部分（device constituent part）如何觸發 QMSR 義務，以及與 21 CFR Part 4 的交叉合規要求
blocks.en: From the perspective of a sterile injectables CDMO, analyze how the device constituent part of pre-filled syringes and autoinjectors triggers QMSR obligations, and the cross-compliance requirements with 21 CFR Part 4

blocks.zh: 0.1 What Is QMSR — The 2024 Final Rule & Its Purpose 0.1 何謂 QMSR — 2024 年最終規則與其目的
blocks.en: 0.1 What Is QMSR — The 2024 Final Rule & Its Purpose

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：QSR → QMSR 是什麼？
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Are the QSR and the QMSR?

blocks.zh: QSR（Quality System Regulation）：1996 年生效的舊法規，FDA 自行撰寫的醫療器材製造要求。條文詳細列出 15 個子部分（Subpart A–O），涵蓋從設計管控到統計技術，每一條都是獨立的聯邦法規條文。
blocks.en: QSR (Quality System Regulation): the old regulation that took effect in 1996, containing FDA's own medical device manufacturing requirements. It listed 15 subparts in detail (Subparts A–O), covering everything from design controls to statistical techniques, and each section was a stand-alone federal regulation.

blocks.zh: QMSR（Quality Management System Regulation）：2024 年最終規則將 Part 820 更名並重構。關鍵改變是在 §820.7 中「引用納入（incorporation by reference）」ISO 13485:2016 這份國際標準——意思是：ISO 13485 的全文，在法律效力上等同於 21 CFR Part 820 的條文。
blocks.en: QMSR (Quality Management System Regulation): the 2024 final rule renamed and restructured Part 820. The key change is that §820.7 "incorporates by reference" the international standard ISO 13485:2016. In other words, the full text of ISO 13485 has the same legal force as the text of 21 CFR Part 820.

blocks.zh: 最重要的比喻：舊的 QSR 像一本 FDA 自己寫的食譜；新的 QMSR 說「我們直接引用 ISO 13485 這本國際食譜，但有幾道菜我們有額外規定」。
blocks.en: The most important analogy: the old QSR was like a cookbook FDA wrote itself. The new QMSR says, "We now cite ISO 13485, the international cookbook, directly, but for a few dishes we have extra rules."

blocks.zh: 生活類比：國際駕照與本地駕照
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy: International vs. Local Driver's License

blocks.zh: 想像你是一家在全球 30 個國家銷售醫療器材的製造商。過去你需要同時持有「ISO 13485 駕照」（給歐盟、加拿大、日本）和「FDA QSR 駕照」（給美國）。這兩張駕照的考試內容 80% 相同，但各有不同格式的試題，你得準備兩套完全分開的文件。
blocks.en: Imagine you are a manufacturer selling medical devices in 30 countries. In the past you needed both an "ISO 13485 license" (for the EU, Canada and Japan) and an "FDA QSR license" (for the US). The exams for the two licenses were 80% identical, but the questions were formatted differently, so you had to prepare two completely separate sets of documents.

blocks.zh: QMSR 的改革等於是說：「美國現在接受 ISO 13485 這張國際駕照為基礎，只需要在幾個美國特有的地方（如 UDI、MDR 報告）額外補充。」一套系統，大幅降低重複工作。
blocks.en: The QMSR reform is like saying: "The US now accepts the ISO 13485 international license as the foundation, and you only need to add a few US-specific items (such as UDI and MDR reporting)." One system, far less duplicated work.

blocks.zh: Incorporation by Reference（引用納入）的法律意義
blocks.en: The Legal Significance of Incorporation by Reference

blocks.zh: 「Incorporation by reference（引用納入）」是美國行政法的技術性機制，讓聯邦機構可以把外部文件（如 ISO 標準）的內容在法律上視同寫入 CFR 條文。
blocks.en: "Incorporation by reference" is a technical mechanism of US administrative law that allows a federal agency to treat the content of an external document (such as an ISO standard) as if it were written into the CFR text.

blocks.zh: 實際意涵：
blocks.en: Practical implications:

blocks.zh: ISO 13485:2016 不是「參考資料」或「業界最佳實踐」——它是 21 CFR 820 的一部分，具有強制法律效力
blocks.en: ISO 13485:2016 is not "reference material" or "industry best practice"; it is part of 21 CFR 820 and is legally mandatory

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠人員可以直接引用 ISO 13485 的子句開立 FDA 483 觀察事項
blocks.en: FDA investigators can cite ISO 13485 clauses directly when issuing FDA 483 observations

blocks.zh: ISO 13485:2016 和 ISO 9000:2015 Clause 3（術語定義）均被引用納入
blocks.en: Both ISO 13485:2016 and Clause 3 (terms and definitions) of ISO 9000:2015 are incorporated by reference

blocks.zh: ANSI（美國國家標準學會）提供 ISO 13485:2016 的免費閱讀版本，符合 1 CFR Part 51 引用規定
blocks.en: ANSI (American National Standards Institute) provides a free read-only version of ISO 13485:2016, in line with the incorporation by reference requirements of 1 CFR Part 51

blocks.zh: 重要警示：現有製造商的過渡義務
blocks.en: Important Warning: Transition Obligations for Existing Manufacturers

blocks.zh: 最終規則於 2024 年 2 月 2 日發布，但生效日期為 2026 年 2 月 2 日——FDA 給了整整兩年的過渡期。
blocks.en: The final rule was published on February 2, 2024, but becomes effective on February 2, 2026, giving a full two-year transition period.

blocks.zh: 過渡期間的義務：
blocks.en: Obligations during the transition period:

blocks.zh: 2024/2/2 至 2026/2/1：製造商仍需遵守舊版 QSR（不可提前「放棄」QSR 合規）
blocks.en: February 2, 2024 to February 1, 2026: manufacturers must still comply with the old QSR (you cannot "drop" QSR compliance early)

blocks.zh: 但如果提前建立 QMSR 相容的系統，FDA 不反對早期採用
blocks.en: However, if you establish a QMSR-compatible system early, FDA does not object to early adoption

blocks.zh: 2026/2/2 起：舊 QSR 條文正式退場，QMSR 完全生效
blocks.en: From February 2, 2026: the old QSR text is formally retired and the QMSR is fully in effect

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著：若客戶在 2025 年進行品質稽核，工廠可能同時被要求展示舊版 QSR 合規和 QMSR 就緒狀態。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means that if a client conducts a quality audit in 2025, the site may be asked to demonstrate both compliance with the old QSR and QMSR readiness.

blocks.zh: 練習問題 Practice Question
blocks.en: Practice Question

blocks.zh: Q1：FDA 在 QMSR 中引用 ISO 13485:2016「incorporation by reference」的主要監管目的為何？請說明此機制如何改變製造商的合規義務。
blocks.en: Q1: What is FDA's main regulatory purpose in incorporating ISO 13485:2016 "by reference" in the QMSR? Explain how this mechanism changes manufacturers' compliance obligations.

blocks.zh: Q2：一家目前持有 ISO 13485:2016 認證的歐洲醫療器材製造商，在 QMSR 生效後是否自動符合 21 CFR Part 820 要求？說明你的理由。
blocks.en: Q2: After the QMSR takes effect, does a European medical device manufacturer that currently holds ISO 13485:2016 certification automatically meet the requirements of 21 CFR Part 820? Explain your reasoning.

blocks.zh: 0.2 Structural Change — QSR vs. QMSR Architecture 0.2 架構變革 — QSR 與 QMSR 架構比較
blocks.en: 0.2 Structural Change — QSR vs. QMSR Architecture

blocks.zh: 架構變化解析：從 15 個子部分到 2 個子部分
blocks.en: Analysis of the Structural Change: From 15 Subparts to 2 Subparts

blocks.zh: 舊版 QSR 就像一棟有 15 間房間的大樓，每間房間（Subpart）都有 FDA 自己寫的規定。QMSR 把這棟大樓重建成只保留 2 間房間（Subpart A 和 Subpart B），但在入口處貼了一張告示：「其他房間的內容，請閱讀 ISO 13485:2016 這本書。」
blocks.en: The old QSR was like a building with 15 rooms, each room (subpart) containing rules written by FDA itself. The QMSR rebuilt the building to keep only 2 rooms (Subpart A and Subpart B), but posted a notice at the entrance: "For the content of the other rooms, please read the book ISO 13485:2016."

blocks.zh: Subpart A（一般條款）包含：
blocks.en: Subpart A (General Provisions) contains:

blocks.zh: §820.1 適用範圍（Scope）
blocks.en: §820.1 Scope

blocks.zh: §820.3 定義（Definitions）
blocks.en: §820.3 Definitions

blocks.zh: §820.7 引用納入（Incorporation by Reference）
blocks.en: §820.7 Incorporation by Reference

blocks.zh: Subpart B（補充條款）包含 FDA 認為 ISO 13485 不夠充分、需額外補充的要求：
blocks.en: Subpart B (Supplementary Provisions) contains the requirements that FDA considered ISO 13485 insufficient on and that needed to be added:

blocks.zh: §820.10 品質管理系統要求（QMS Requirements）
blocks.en: §820.10 Requirements for a Quality Management System (QMS Requirements)

blocks.zh: §820.35 記錄控制（Control of Records）——移除稽核記錄豁免
blocks.en: §820.35 Control of Records: removes the exemption for audit records

blocks.zh: §820.45 標籤與包裝管控（Labeling & Packaging Controls）——強制實體標籤查驗
blocks.en: §820.45 Device Labeling and Packaging Controls: mandates physical label inspection

blocks.zh: 關鍵警示：ISO 13485 認證不等於 FDA 免查
blocks.en: Key Warning: ISO 13485 Certification Does Not Mean Exemption from FDA Inspection

blocks.zh: 這是 QMSR 中最常見的誤解，必須在查廠準備中清楚傳達：
blocks.en: This is the most common misunderstanding about the QMSR and must be communicated clearly in inspection preparation:

blocks.zh: 即使你的工廠擁有有效的 ISO 13485:2016 認證書，FDA 仍然有權進行 21 CFR Part 820 查廠，且查廠結果可以開立 FDA 483 和 Warning Letter。
blocks.en: Even if your site holds a valid ISO 13485:2016 certificate, FDA still has the authority to inspect under 21 CFR Part 820, and the inspection results can lead to an FDA 483 and a Warning Letter.

blocks.zh: 唯一的例外是 MDSAP（Medical Device Single Audit Program，醫療器材單一稽核計畫）。參與 MDSAP 的工廠可以用 MDSAP 稽核報告替代 FDA 例行查廠，但這是一個獨立計畫，不是 ISO 13485 認證本身提供的豁免。
blocks.en: The only exception is MDSAP (Medical Device Single Audit Program). Sites participating in MDSAP can substitute an MDSAP audit report for a routine FDA inspection, but this is a separate program; the exemption is not provided by ISO 13485 certification itself.

blocks.zh: FDA 在最終規則的前言中明確說明：ISO 13485 認證是有用的品質指標，但不構成合規的法律依據。
blocks.en: In the preamble to the final rule, FDA states explicitly that ISO 13485 certification is a useful quality indicator but does not constitute a legal basis for compliance.

blocks.zh: §820.45 標籤查驗：為何自動化不夠？
blocks.en: §820.45 Label Inspection: Why Is Automation Not Enough?

blocks.zh: 這個 FDA 特有要求值得特別注意：ISO 13485 只要求標籤查驗，但沒有要求「實體（physical）」查驗。FDA 在 QMSR 中特別補充，標籤查驗必須包含由人員對代表性樣本進行實體查驗——即使你有全自動視覺系統，仍需要一道人工確認步驟。
blocks.en: This FDA-specific requirement deserves particular attention: ISO 13485 only requires label inspection, not "physical" inspection. FDA added to the QMSR that label inspection must include physical inspection of a representative sample by personnel. Even if you have a fully automated vision system, a manual verification step is still required.

blocks.zh: 想像工廠的貼標機有視覺系統確認 UDI 條碼。QMSR 要求：在放行前，質控人員還必須親自拿起幾瓶，用眼睛確認標籤正確——視覺系統和人工查驗是加法關係，不是替代關係。
blocks.en: Imagine the plant's labeling machine has a vision system that confirms the UDI barcode. The QMSR requires that, before release, QC personnel must also pick up a few units and visually confirm that the label is correct. The vision system and the manual inspection are additive, not substitutes for each other.

blocks.zh: Q3：一家無菌注射劑 CDMO 客戶要求提供器材組成部分（預充式注射器）的「Device Master Record（DMR）」。你作為品質主管，應如何回應？在 QMSR 框架下，正確的文件術語和架構應為何？
blocks.en: Q3: A sterile injectables CDMO client asks you to provide the "Device Master Record (DMR)" for the device constituent part (pre-filled syringe). As quality head, how should you respond? Under the QMSR framework, what should the correct document terminology and structure be?

blocks.zh: Q4：說明 QSR §820.20（管理職責）在 QMSR 下對應到 ISO 13485:2016 的哪個子句，以及 FDA 在 Subpart B 中有無額外補充要求。
blocks.en: Q4: Explain which clause of ISO 13485:2016 QSR §820.20 (Management Responsibility) maps to under the QMSR, and whether FDA adds any supplementary requirements in Subpart B.

blocks.zh: 重要術語更新：DHF / DMR / DHR → MDF
blocks.en: Important Terminology Update: DHF / DMR / DHR → MDF

blocks.zh: 這是 QMSR 最具體的操作性改變之一，直接影響現場文件管理：
blocks.en: This is one of the most concrete operational changes in the QMSR and directly affects document management on site:

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的實際影響：如果客戶要求提供「DMR」，工廠文件系統現在應對應到 MDF 架構。建議在品質協議（Quality Agreement）中明確約定術語映射關係。
blocks.en: Practical impact on a CDMO: if a client asks for the "DMR", the site's document system should now map to the MDF structure. We recommend that the terminology mapping be agreed explicitly in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: 0.3 Who Must Comply — Scope of Applicability & Transition Timeline 0.3 適用對象 — 適用範圍與過渡期時程
blocks.en: 0.3 Who Must Comply — Scope of Applicability & Transition Timeline

blocks.zh: 誰要遵守 QMSR？一個實用判斷框架
blocks.en: Who Must Comply with the QMSR? A Practical Decision Framework

blocks.zh: 判斷是否適用 QMSR 的核心問題只有兩個：
blocks.en: There are only two core questions for deciding whether the QMSR applies:

blocks.zh: 你製造的是「finished device（成品器材）」嗎？
blocks.en: Do you manufacture a "finished device"?

blocks.zh: 是 → 必須符合 QMSR
blocks.en: Yes → you must comply with the QMSR

blocks.zh: 否（只是零件/元件供應商）→ 不強制，但建議遵循
blocks.en: No (you only supply parts/components) → not mandatory, but compliance is recommended

blocks.zh: 你的器材是打算在美國上市嗎？
blocks.en: Is your device intended to be marketed in the US?

blocks.zh: 是 → 即使工廠在美國境外，仍適用 QMSR
blocks.en: Yes → the QMSR applies even if the site is outside the US

blocks.zh: 否（純粹出口至其他市場）→ 21 CFR Part 820 不適用（但其他國家法規可能適用）
blocks.en: No (exported solely to other markets) → 21 CFR Part 820 does not apply (but other countries' regulations may apply)

blocks.zh: 合約製造商（CDMO/CMO）的特殊地位
blocks.en: The Special Status of Contract Manufacturers (CDMO/CMO)

blocks.zh: 這是無菌注射劑 CDMO 最需要掌握的核心概念之一。
blocks.en: This is one of the core concepts that a sterile injectables CDMO most needs to master.

blocks.zh: CDMO 的雙重義務：如果你的 CDMO 接受委托生產「finished device」（例如最終充填好、密封好、無菌的預充式注射器），你就是 QMSR 意義下的「manufacturer（製造商）」，不論客戶是誰或品牌屬於誰。
blocks.en: The CDMO's dual obligations: if your CDMO accepts contract production of a "finished device" (for example, a fully filled, sealed, sterile pre-filled syringe), you are a "manufacturer" within the meaning of the QMSR, regardless of who the client is or whose brand it is.

blocks.zh: CDMO 適用的 QMSR 工作範圍（取決於合約範圍）：
blocks.en: QMSR scope of work applicable to a CDMO (depending on the contract scope):

blocks.zh: 充填、密封、無菌加工 → 生產與製程管控（ISO 13485 §7.5）
blocks.en: Filling, sealing and aseptic processing → production and process controls (ISO 13485 §7.5)

blocks.zh: 標籤與包裝作業 → §820.45 實體標籤查驗
blocks.en: Labeling and packaging operations → §820.45 physical label inspection

blocks.zh: 最終放行（Final Release）→ §820.35 記錄要求
blocks.en: Final release → §820.35 record requirements

blocks.zh: 客戶設計的器材 → 可能涉及設計傳遞文件（MDF）
blocks.en: Client-designed devices → may involve design transfer documentation (MDF)

blocks.zh: 類比：代工廠的法規責任
blocks.en: Analogy: Regulatory Responsibility of a Contract Manufacturer

blocks.zh: 想像知名品牌 A 委托工廠 B 生產預充式注射器（filled with drug product）。品牌 A 設計、擁有 510(k)、負責上市許可。
blocks.en: Imagine a well-known brand A contracts factory B to produce pre-filled syringes (filled with drug product). Brand A designs the device, holds the 510(k) and is responsible for the marketing authorization.

blocks.zh: 但工廠 B 仍然是 QMSR 下的「製造商」，需要建立和維護符合 ISO 13485:2016 的品質系統。如果 FDA 到工廠 B 查廠，發現製程管控不足，工廠 B 可以收到 FDA 483，甚至 Warning Letter——即使所有產品的品牌名稱都是 A 的。
blocks.en: But factory B is still a "manufacturer" under the QMSR and must establish and maintain a quality system that complies with ISO 13485:2016. If FDA inspects factory B and finds inadequate process controls, factory B can receive an FDA 483 or even a Warning Letter, even though every product carries A's brand name.

blocks.zh: 合約不能「轉移」製造商的 QMSR 義務。
blocks.en: A contract cannot "transfer" a manufacturer's QMSR obligations.

blocks.zh: 過渡期策略建議（實務角度）
blocks.en: Recommended Transition Strategy (Practical Perspective)

blocks.zh: 有效的 QMSR 過渡計畫應包含以下步驟（建議在 2026/2/2 前完成）：
blocks.en: An effective QMSR transition plan should include the following steps (we recommend completing them before February 2, 2026):

blocks.zh: 差距分析（Gap Analysis）：對照 ISO 13485:2016 條款與舊 QSR 的現行程序，識別文件和實務的差距
blocks.en: Gap analysis: compare the ISO 13485:2016 clauses against the current procedures under the old QSR, and identify gaps in documentation and practice

blocks.zh: 術語更新：DHF → MDF、DMR → MDF、DHR → 相關生產紀錄，更新所有 SOP、表格、訓練材料
blocks.en: Terminology update: DHF → MDF, DMR → MDF, DHR → relevant production records; update all SOPs, forms and training materials

blocks.zh: 新增要求落實
blocks.en: Implementation of new requirements

blocks.zh: 品質手冊（Quality Manual）建立（若尚未有）
blocks.en: Establish a Quality Manual (if you do not yet have one)

blocks.zh: §820.45 標籤實體查驗程序更新
blocks.en: Update the §820.45 physical label inspection procedure

blocks.zh: §820.35 移除稽核記錄豁免——確認管理審查和內部稽核記錄已納入 FDA 可查閱範圍
blocks.en: §820.35 removal of the audit record exemption: confirm that management review and internal audit records are within the scope FDA can access

blocks.zh: 訓練：全體人員了解 QMSR 架構變化，特別是 QMS 主管和法規事務人員
blocks.en: Training: all personnel should understand the architectural changes in the QMSR, especially QMS managers and regulatory affairs staff

blocks.zh: 文件更新聲明：在供應商問卷、客戶品質協議中更新對 ISO 13485:2016 和 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR 的聲明
blocks.en: Updated declarations: update the statements on ISO 13485:2016 and 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR in supplier questionnaires and client Quality Agreements

blocks.zh: Q5：一家僅供應橡膠活塞（rubber stoppers）給無菌注射劑 CDMO 的供應商是否需要符合 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR？說明理由，並指出他們在 ISO 13485 體系下的地位。
blocks.en: Q5: Does a supplier that only provides rubber stoppers to a sterile injectables CDMO need to comply with 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR? Explain why, and state their status under the ISO 13485 system.

blocks.zh: Q6：你的工廠目前以舊版 QSR 通過 FDA 查廠。2025 年客戶來稽核，問你「QMSR 準備狀況如何」。你應展示哪些文件或活動，才能讓客戶確認你已在過渡期中積極推進？
blocks.en: Q6: Your site currently passes FDA inspections under the old QSR. In 2025 a client comes to audit and asks, "What is your QMSR readiness?" What documents or activities should you show to give the client confidence that you are actively progressing during the transition period?

blocks.zh: 0.4 Combination Products & CDMO Relevance — Cross-Regulatory Obligations 0.4 組合產品與 CDMO 相關性 — 跨法規義務
blocks.en: 0.4 Combination Products & CDMO Relevance — Cross-Regulatory Obligations

blocks.zh: 核心概念：組合產品（Combination Product）的雙重 CGMP 義務
blocks.en: Core Concept: Dual CGMP Obligations for Combination Products

blocks.zh: 這是無菌注射劑 CDMO 最需要深刻理解的監管邏輯，因為許多現代生物製劑產品（單株抗體、胰島素、疫苗等）都以預充式注射器或自動注射器形式上市。
blocks.en: This is the regulatory logic a sterile injectables CDMO most needs to understand deeply, because many modern biologic products (monoclonal antibodies, insulin, vaccines and so on) are marketed as pre-filled syringes or autoinjectors.

blocks.zh: 關鍵判斷：Primary Mode of Action (PMOA，主要作用模式)
blocks.en: Key determination: Primary Mode of Action (PMOA)

blocks.zh: FDA 根據 PMOA 決定哪一個 CGMP 體系是「主要」的：
blocks.en: FDA uses the PMOA to decide which CGMP system is the "primary" one:

blocks.zh: 如果治療效果主要來自藥物成分（如胰島素）→ 21 CFR Parts 210/211 是主要法規
blocks.en: If the therapeutic effect comes mainly from the drug component (such as insulin) → 21 CFR Parts 210/211 are the primary regulations

blocks.zh: 如果治療效果主要來自器材設計（如藥物洗脫支架的機械擴張）→ 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR 是主要法規
blocks.en: If the therapeutic effect comes mainly from the device design (such as the mechanical expansion of a drug-eluting stent) → 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR is the primary regulation

blocks.zh: 但無論哪個是「主要」，另一個法規仍然適用——這就是「雙重 CGMP 義務」。
blocks.en: But whichever is "primary", the other regulation still applies. This is the "dual CGMP obligation."

blocks.zh: CDMO 現場警示：預充式注射器的雙重義務觸發點
blocks.en: CDMO Floor Alert: Trigger Points for Dual Obligations in Pre-Filled Syringes

blocks.zh: 無菌注射劑 CDMO 常見的誤解：「我只是充填藥液，注射器筒體是客戶提供的，我不需要管 Part 820。」
blocks.en: A common misunderstanding among sterile injectables CDMOs: "I only fill the drug solution; the syringe barrel is supplied by the client, so I do not need to worry about Part 820."

blocks.zh: 這是錯誤的。以下情況都會觸發 QMSR 義務：
blocks.en: This is wrong. The following situations all trigger QMSR obligations:

blocks.zh: CDMO 執行充填密封（fill-finish）後，最終產品是一個「充填好的預充式注射器」——這是 21 CFR § 3.2(e) 定義下的組合產品器材組成部分
blocks.en: After the CDMO performs fill-finish, the final product is a "filled pre-filled syringe", which is the device constituent part of a combination product as defined in 21 CFR § 3.2(e)

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 是該組合產品的唯一製造商（即同時製造藥品和器材組成）→ 需同時符合 21 CFR 211 和 Part 820 QMSR
blocks.en: If the CDMO is the sole manufacturer of the combination product (that is, it makes both the drug and the device constituent part) → it must comply with both 21 CFR 211 and Part 820 QMSR

blocks.zh: 即使客戶負責 510(k) 或 PMA，CDMO 仍是 Part 820 下的「製造商」
blocks.en: Even if the client is responsible for the 510(k) or PMA, the CDMO is still a "manufacturer" under Part 820

blocks.zh: 實際合規建議：在品質協議中明確劃分哪一方負責哪部分的 QMSR 要求（尤其是 MDF 的維護責任）。
blocks.en: Practical compliance recommendation: in the Quality Agreement, define clearly which party is responsible for which part of the QMSR requirements (especially responsibility for maintaining the MDF).

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用情境 CDMO Application Scenario
blocks.en: CDMO Application Scenario

blocks.zh: 情境：一家台灣無菌注射劑 CDMO 接受委托，充填一款單株抗體藥物至 Uniject™ 預填充自動注射系統，最終交給客戶貼標後上市美國。客戶持有 BLA（Biologics License Application），CDMO 持有 DMF（Drug Master File）。
blocks.en: Scenario: a Taiwanese sterile injectables CDMO is contracted to fill a monoclonal antibody drug into a Uniject™ prefillable autoinjection system, which is handed to the client for labeling and marketing in the US. The client holds the BLA (Biologics License Application) and the CDMO holds the DMF (Drug Master File).

blocks.zh: CDMO 的監管義務矩陣：
blocks.en: The CDMO's regulatory obligations matrix:

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Parts 210/211：充填、無菌加工、環境監測、最終放行——這是主要 CGMP（藥品為 PMOA）
blocks.en: 21 CFR Parts 210/211: filling, aseptic processing, environmental monitoring and final release. This is the primary CGMP (the drug is the PMOA)

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR：器材組成部分（自動注射系統）的品質管理——涵蓋 ISO 13485 要求的採購控制（Clause 7.4）、生產與服務提供（Clause 7.5）
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR: quality management of the device constituent part (the autoinjection system), covering the purchasing controls (Clause 7.4) and production and service provision (Clause 7.5) required by ISO 13485

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 4：確認雙重 CGMP 框架的適用性，釐清與客戶的責任分工
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 4: confirm how the dual CGMP framework applies and clarify the division of responsibilities with the client

blocks.zh: 21 CFR Part 830：確認 UDI 要求是否適用，以及在標籤上的呈現
blocks.en: 21 CFR Part 830: confirm whether the UDI requirements apply and how they are presented on the label

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 §7.4：對 Uniject™ 系統供應商的採購控制文件
blocks.en: ISO 13485 §7.4: purchasing control documentation for the Uniject™ system supplier

blocks.zh: 查廠準備重點：若 FDA 查廠聚焦在器材組成部分，查廠人員會審查：設計傳遞文件（從供應商取得的 MDF 相關資料）、對器材組成部分的入庫驗收記錄、§820.45 標籤實體查驗記錄、以及品質協議中對 QMSR 責任的明確約定。
blocks.en: Inspection preparation focus: if an FDA inspection focuses on the device constituent part, investigators will review the design transfer documentation (MDF-related information obtained from the supplier), incoming acceptance records for the device constituent part, §820.45 physical label inspection records, and the explicit agreement on QMSR responsibilities in the Quality Agreement.

blocks.zh: FD&C Act 優先於 ISO 13485：衝突時怎麼辦？
blocks.en: The FD&C Act Takes Precedence over ISO 13485: What Happens in a Conflict?

blocks.zh: §820.1(b) 的 FD&C Act 優先條款非常重要，它說明了 ISO 13485 在 QMSR 框架下的法律地位：
blocks.en: The FD&C Act precedence clause in §820.1(b) is very important; it describes the legal status of ISO 13485 within the QMSR framework:

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 雖然被「引用納入」21 CFR Part 820，但它不是美國法律的源頭——FD&C Act 和 FDA 法規才是。當 ISO 13485 的某個要求與 FDA 的具體法規發生衝突時，FDA 的規定優先。
blocks.en: Although ISO 13485 is "incorporated by reference" into 21 CFR Part 820, it is not the source of US law; the FD&C Act and FDA regulations are. When a requirement in ISO 13485 conflicts with a specific FDA regulation, the FDA requirement prevails.

blocks.zh: 實例：ISO 13485 對標籤查驗的要求比 FDA §820.45 更寬鬆。此時，§820.45 的要求優先，即使你完全符合 ISO 13485，若沒有執行物理性標籤查驗，仍屬 FDA 違規。
blocks.en: Example: ISO 13485's label inspection requirement is less strict than FDA §820.45. In that case the §820.45 requirement prevails: even if you fully comply with ISO 13485, failing to perform physical label inspection is still an FDA violation.

blocks.zh: 這個原則也適用於：ISO 13485 中使用「安全與性能（safety and performance）」，而 FDA 解讀為「安全與有效性（safety and effectiveness）」——後者是美國法律的標準語言。
blocks.en: This principle also applies to the following: ISO 13485 uses "safety and performance", whereas FDA interprets this as "safety and effectiveness", the latter being the standard language of US law.

blocks.zh: Q7：一款 GLP-1 受體促效劑（如 Semaglutide）以預充式自動注射器上市，FDA 認定其 PMOA 為藥品。請列出該組合產品製造商（CDMO）需同時符合的所有主要 FDA 法規，並說明各法規的適用範圍。
blocks.en: Q7: A GLP-1 receptor agonist (such as semaglutide) is marketed in a pre-filled autoinjector, and FDA has determined its PMOA to be the drug. List all the main FDA regulations that the combination product manufacturer (the CDMO) must comply with at the same time, and explain the scope of each.

blocks.zh: Q8（進階）：ISO 13485:2016 對「risk（風險）」的定義與 ISO 14971 有何不同？FDA 在 QMSR 最終規則的前言中，如何說明對 ISO 14971 的立場？對 CDMO 的實際操作有何影響？
blocks.en: Q8 (Advanced): How does the ISO 13485:2016 definition of "risk" differ from that in ISO 14971? How does FDA state its position on ISO 14971 in the preamble to the QMSR final rule? What is the practical impact on CDMO operations?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: QSR → QMSR 的本質：FDA 2024 年最終規則（89 FR 7496）將 21 CFR Part 820 重命名為 QMSR，核心改變是在 §820.7 引用納入 ISO 13485:2016 和 ISO 9000:2015 Clause 3，使這兩份國際標準具有與 CFR 條文同等的法律強制效力，生效日期為 2026 年 2 月 2 日。
blocks.en: The essence of QSR → QMSR: the FDA 2024 final rule (89 FR 7496) renamed 21 CFR Part 820 as the QMSR. The core change is that §820.7 incorporates by reference ISO 13485:2016 and Clause 3 of ISO 9000:2015, giving these two international standards the same legal force as CFR text. The effective date is February 2, 2026.

blocks.zh: 架構大幅精簡：舊 QSR 的 15 個子部分（Subpart A–O）中，Subpart C–O 全部標注為「Reserved」，實質要求移至 ISO 13485。QMSR 保留 Subpart A（一般條款：§§820.1、820.3、820.7）和 Subpart B（補充條款：§§820.10、820.35、820.45）。
blocks.en: A much leaner architecture: of the old QSR's 15 subparts (Subparts A–O), Subparts C–O are all marked "Reserved", and the substantive requirements moved to ISO 13485. The QMSR keeps Subpart A (General Provisions: §§820.1, 820.3, 820.7) and Subpart B (Supplementary Provisions: §§820.10, 820.35, 820.45).

blocks.zh: FDA 特有補充要求不可忽視：三個 FDA-specific 要求超越了 ISO 13485 的基本要求——§820.35 移除了管理審查和稽核記錄的豁免（FDA 現在可查閱這些記錄）、§820.45 要求對標籤代表性樣本進行實體查驗（自動化系統不能完全替代）、以及 §820.10 要求「applicable regulatory requirements」包含所有相關 FDA 法規。
blocks.en: FDA-specific additional requirements cannot be ignored: three FDA-specific requirements go beyond the basic requirements of ISO 13485. §820.35 removes the exemption for management review and audit records (FDA can now review these records); §820.45 requires physical inspection of representative samples of labels (an automated system cannot fully replace it); and §820.10 requires that "applicable regulatory requirements" include all relevant FDA regulations.

blocks.zh: 合規對象範圍：finished device 製造商（Class I/II/III）、規格開發商、合約製造商（CDMO/CMO）、合約滅菌商、再製造商和境外製造商的初始美國進口商——全部需要符合 QMSR。純元件製造商不強制，但建議遵循。
blocks.en: Who must comply: manufacturers of finished devices (Class I/II/III), specification developers, contract manufacturers (CDMO/CMO), contract sterilizers, remanufacturers and the initial US importers of foreign manufacturers must all comply with the QMSR. Component-only manufacturers are not required to, but compliance is recommended.

blocks.zh: 組合產品的雙重 CGMP 義務：含有器材組成部分的組合產品（如藥物充填的預充式注射器、自動注射器）需同時符合 21 CFR Parts 210/211（藥品 CGMP）和 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR（器材組成部分），適用比例由 21 CFR Part 4 框架決定。
blocks.en: Dual CGMP obligations for combination products: combination products containing a device constituent part (such as drug-filled pre-filled syringes and autoinjectors) must comply with both 21 CFR Parts 210/211 (drug CGMP) and 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR (for the device constituent part); how they apply is determined by the 21 CFR Part 4 framework.

blocks.zh: CDMO 現場要點：無菌注射劑 CDMO 若執行組合產品的充填密封，即為 QMSR 意義下的器材製造商。必須在品質協議中明確 QMSR 責任分工，特別是 MDF（Medical Device File）的維護責任、ISO 13485 採購控制（Clause 7.4）對器材組成部分供應商的適用，以及 §820.45 標籤實體查驗的執行記錄。
blocks.en: Key CDMO points on site: a sterile injectables CDMO that performs fill-finish of a combination product is a device manufacturer within the meaning of the QMSR. The Quality Agreement must define the division of QMSR responsibilities, especially responsibility for maintaining the MDF (Medical Device File), the application of ISO 13485 purchasing controls (Clause 7.4) to suppliers of the device constituent part, and the execution records for §820.45 physical label inspection.

blocks.zh: ISO 13485 認證不等於 FDA 免查：持有 ISO 13485:2016 認證僅表明符合國際標準，不能豁免 FDA 依 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR 進行查廠的權力。唯一能替代 FDA 例行查廠的是 MDSAP 計畫的稽核結果。FD&C Act 和 FDA 法規在任何衝突情況下均優先於 ISO 13485。
blocks.en: ISO 13485 certification does not mean exemption from FDA inspection: holding ISO 13485:2016 certification only shows conformity to an international standard; it does not remove FDA's authority to inspect under 21 CFR Part 820 QMSR. The only thing that can replace a routine FDA inspection is an audit result from the MDSAP program. The FD&C Act and FDA regulations take precedence over ISO 13485 in any conflict.
